up: Return the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513217. Include the standardized activity measurements (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units) where standard_relation = '=' to obtain exact values. Also include the canonical SMILES of each tested compound. Do not add any row limit or additional filters.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513217' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
